vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mma-bridge
Version: 1.2.4

The mma-bridge skill is a legitimate integration for the 'Meteor Master AI' application, providing a CLI-based interface to manage meteor detection data. It includes commands for system checks, application startup, and API interaction via a local bridge (mma-bridge). The skill uses standard local communication (127.0.0.1), references official app store links, and lacks any indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose — it is an instruction-only adapter for the local mma-bridge CLI and expects to read/write local files and talk to a local MMA service — but you should only install it if you trust the external npm package and are comfortable the agent will run shell commands and access local files/localhost ports.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md clearly documents a CLI-based bridge to a local Meteor Master AI instance and requires the mma-bridge CLI (npm install mma-bridge -g) and typical shell utilities (powershell, echo). The registry metadata for the skill declares no required binaries/env but the runtime instructions assume a CLI and shell are available — a minor mismatch but coherent with the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions keep to the stated scope: using mma check/start/list/post to interact with a local MMA app, reading/writing temporary JSON files and probing localhost ports (health endpoints). They do reference system temp directories and deleting invalid instance files; this is proportionate to listing/cleaning local MMA instances but means the agent will access the filesystem and localhost network.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is embedded in the skill bundle (instruction-only), which is low-risk. However SKILL.md tells the user to run 'npm install mma-bridge -g' — installing an external npm package is required for the skill to function. The skill does not bundle or vouch for that package, so you should vet the npm package before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or external credentials. Example data in the docs includes an RTSP URL with embedded credentials as an example only; the skill itself does not ask for unrelated secrets. Overall the requested access (filesystem, localhost ports) is proportional to interacting with a local desktop application.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated platform privileges. It does instruct local file deletion in the temp registry for cleanup, but it does not attempt to modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only helper to operate a local CLI (mma-bridge) that talks to a local Meteor Master AI application. Before installing or using it: 1) verify and trust the npm package 'mma-bridge' (the SKILL.md tells you to run npm install -g) — malicious npm packages are a common risk; 2) understand the skill will run shell commands, write/read JSON files (e.g., data.json), and query localhost ports (default 9000) and system temp directories — so only use it on machines where you trust the local MMA app and avoid including sensitive credentials in request data; 3) review any files/output paths produced by the MMA app (exported videos/images) if those files contain sensitive data; 4) if you need a stricter security posture, avoid installing the npm CLI and interact with MMA manually or review the npm package code first.
